title: Research & Publications
description: Peer-reviewed and forthcoming work on medical image analysis, latency-aware benchmarking, and fairness in clinical machine learning.

items.title: Brain Tumor MRI Classification using Enhanced DenseNet169
items.description: A robust deep learning framework for classifying brain tumors (Glioma, Meningioma, Normal, Pituitary) from MRI scans. Achieved 98.60% accuracy using an enhanced DenseNet169 backbone with 5-fold cross-validation, custom data augmentation, and Grad-CAM explainability, with perfect classification of Pituitary tumors.

items.title: Latency-Aware Benchmarking of Deep Learning Models for RF Signal Classification
items.venue: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Microwave, Antennas, RF and Sensors (MARSCON)
items.description: Accepted, in press. Benchmarks deep learning architectures for radio-frequency signal classification, with a focus on inference latency alongside predictive accuracy.

items.title: Exploring Metabolic Subgroups and Algorithmic Fairness in a Bangladesh Type-2 Diabetes Cohort: An Explainable Machine Learning Case Study
items.authors: F. A. Onu, S. M., J. K. Das
items.description: Applied explainable machine learning to a Bangladeshi Type-2 diabetes cohort to identify metabolic subgroups and assess algorithmic fairness across them — examining how subgroup-specific model behaviour may introduce bias in clinical risk prediction. Conducted as part of the BSc research project.
